objective: Reduce Store replay cost while preserving checked history

goals.objective: Reduce native Store application projection latency while preserving checked history
goals.workload: Native state_projection case: events_10000, application_cold and prewarmed instances, seed/setup excluded exactly as the frozen native plan declares.
acceptance: Either at least 10 percent lower paired median wall_ms on the same declared workload with verified native measured paired timing and independent verification, or an independently accepted no-worthwhile-optimization research report proving why no candidate in this bounded scope justifies its cost and uncertainty.
guardrails: Identical replayed Task identities, accounting and acceptance
remaining_work: Research, implement if worthwhile, experiment, verify and report this goal
